name: token-killer
description: Rewrites git status, git diff, git show and recursive grep into token-compact forms, then compacts command output inside Claude Code: git, grep and rg, directory listings, docker and kubectl, flux, gh, pytest, vitest, playwright, npm, cargo, go, and host listings. No external binary, zero process spawns.

maxStatusFiles.title: Status entries
maxStatusFiles.description: Changed and untracked entries listed before the rest are elided with a count.

maxDiffLinesPerFile.title: Diff lines per file
maxDiffLinesPerFile.description: Kept hunk lines per file in a large git diff.

maxDiffTotalLines.title: Diff lines in total
maxDiffTotalLines.description: Kept diff lines across every file in one diff.

maxGrepPerFile.title: Matches per file
maxGrepPerFile.description: Kept matches per file before the rest are counted.

maxGrepTotal.title: Matches in total
maxGrepTotal.description: Kept matches across every file in one search.

maxLineLen.title: Match line length
maxLineLen.description: Longer match lines are truncated at this many characters.

maxDirEntries.title: Directory entries
maxDirEntries.description: Entries listed before the rest are elided with a count. ls, find and a recursive Get-ChildItem share one budget across every directory; a non-recursive multi-path call gets it per directory.

maxCmdletRows.title: Cmdlet rows
maxCmdletRows.description: Rows kept from Get-Process, Get-Service, Get-NetTCPConnection, Get-CimInstance, Get-Command, Get-Module, Get-WinEvent and Get-Help before the rest are counted.

maxDiagLines.title: Build diagnostics
maxDiagLines.description: Compiler diagnostics kept from dotnet build and dotnet test before the rest are counted. A diagnostic repeated per project counts once.

notify.title: Savings toast
notify.description: Show a toast with the bytes saved when a call saved at least 200 bytes.
